coordination.reason: No shared immutable request/macrocycle id is exposed to this organ; available user-turn time is minute precision only.

source_delta.protocol_change: TRIGGER1_INTERMEDIATE_CONTRASTIVE_PROTOCOL/v2 -> v3; wrong-layer specificity now compares absolute selected-layer and wrong-layer effect magnitudes, reconstructing the actual wrong-layer effect from the executor's existing relative-delta contract.
source_delta.regression: A selected +VECTOR effect of +3 and wrong-layer effect of -10 (encoded by existing executor as wrong_layer_delta=-13) must fail; the previous signed <=0 rule could accept it.

finding.observed_adjudicator_before_delta: Protocol v2 accepted wrong-layer evidence when wrong_layer_delta <= 0.
finding.counterexample: selected effect +3, wrong-layer effect -10 => wrong_layer_delta -13; old signed check passes despite a larger off-target magnitude.
finding.interpretation: Signed relative ordering is insufficient as a specificity falsifier when a large opposite-sign off-target effect is possible.
finding.repair: Require min(abs(selected_effect)-abs(wrong_layer_effect)) > 0 across all matched holdout cases.

parallel_fusion_context.selected_vector_fix_delta: Current main now forces the wrong-layer localization run to reuse the byte-identical selected-layer vector while changing only intervention layer.
parallel_fusion_context.remaining_gap: The exact-current protocol still uses signed wrong_layer_delta <= 0, so a larger opposite-sign wrong-layer effect can still false-pass even after selected-vector identity is fixed.

counterhypothesis.claim: Opposite-sign wrong-layer effects might be scientifically harmless because only target-direction improvement matters.
counterhypothesis.adjudication: Rejected for causal-localization promotion scope: a larger intervention effect at the wrong layer is material off-target evidence even when its sign is reversed. The observation can remain useful as behavior evidence, but cannot satisfy layer-specific causal promotion.
